note: Planned localisation surface for the 12 reserved F7b examples. Each example must ship with title+desc (catalogue.translations) and question+goal (metadata.content) complete in all five supported locales. Wording is semantically equivalent across languages, with correct native UTF-8 orthography (accents, diacritics, apostrophes, umlauts). Final copy is applied when the tranche goes live in Phase 2.

desc.en: Choose standard and premium output to maximise profit within machine and assembly hours
